title: The Eve of the Recharge
skyStory: The moon is full tonight, ninety-eight percent lit and still lounging in Taurus like a pearl on a velvet cushion. It is the first full moon since this page woke up, and rumour says the first proper snowflakes of the season are queuing behind it. Tomorrow the moon will be at its absolute brightest. Tonight is the dress rehearsal, and it is already showing off.

reading: Full moons turn the volume up, and the Tiger is already loud. Today you will feel everything a little more: the good news, the small annoyances, the beauty of frost on a windshield. Notice which one gets most of your attention, then deliberately give the beautiful one twice as long.

Tonight is preparation. Find the bracelet, clean it gently with a soft cloth, and set it by the window where moonlight will reach it tomorrow. While you do, think of one thing you are ready to let go of. Not a big thing. A grudge against a printer counts. [[The Sun]] is warming up backstage and wants the room tidy.
joel.mission: Find the brightest window in the house and clear one small spot on its sill for tomorrow's ritual.
joel.omen: The first snowflake landing on your sleeve. Something new is starting, and it chose you specifically.
joel.stoneWhy: moon stone on the moon's eve

reading: The Wood Rat feels the full moon in its whiskers before anyone else does. You will be sharper today, quicker with a joke, faster to see the end of someone's sentence before they get there. Let them finish anyway. It is kinder, and you are usually right, which makes it twice as fun to wait.

Tonight, polish the ruby on your pinky and give it a little pep talk. Tomorrow it gets a full charge under the brightest moon of the season, and it should be ready. The mother of pearl wants in too. It is water, after all, and full moons pull on every tide, even the small one on your ring finger.
nancy.mission: Say goodnight to the moon out loud from a doorway, as if it is a neighbour you are fond of.
nancy.omen: A ring around the moon. Change is coming, and it is bringing good company with it.
nancy.stoneWhy: the tide stone, at high tide

together.text: Tomorrow is the Full Moon Recharge. Tonight, agree on a time to do it together, even miles apart. Pick it like a launch window: exact to the minute. Then both set an alarm with a ridiculous label, like Moon Laundry or Stone Spa Appointment.

game.intro: Recharge eve! The moon is nearly full and buzzing like a fridge. Answer before it hums at you.
